detailed_descriptions.en: GHALYAN'S HOOKAH LOUNGE IS UNDER NEW MANAGEMENT! A co-op hookah shop simulator for you and up to three friends. Your cargo pod just docked at a space station with empty pockets and a lounge to run. The last owner left in a hurry. Nobody asked why. THE BOWL WON'T PACK ITSELF Pack the bowl, stretch the foil, poke the holes, heat the coals. Then do it all again, faster, because table six is getting angry. Brew coffee, blend Nebulas, microwave burgers and get every order to the right alien before their patience runs out. THE CUSTOMER IS ALWAYS HUNGRY Ships drop off a steady stream of alien customers, and some pull up to the drive-thru without even landing. Most of them just want a smoke. Some of them want to eat the staff. HOT COALS, COLD FEET Everything on this station runs on real physics, and that includes you. Touch a hot coal and you catch fire, stand in front of the wrong hatch and you get launched into space, fall from too high and you hit the floor like a sack of potatoes. Thanks to proximity chat, everyone hears you panic before they see why. GRAVITY NOT INCLUDED The station's gravity generator is not exactly reliable. Without warning it cuts out, and hookahs, coals, customers and crewmates all lift off the floor. When it kicks back in, everything in the air lands at once. Can you still deliver the orders mid-flight? FROM BARE WALLS TO THE COZIEST SPOT ON THE STATION Every credit goes back into your shop. Hang paintings, roll out carpets, install an aquarium, spruce up the place, open the drive-thru and unlock the elevator. Every upgrade shows up in the lounge and brings in more cash. Become the best shopkeepers in the galaxy, or at least the loudest. Money left over? Buy a G-String. FEATURES Online co-op for 1 to 4 players, or run the shop solo Proximity voice chat (screaming included) Full hookah prep: tobacco, foil, coals, smoke Coffee, Nebulas, sodas, burgers and sandwiches Alien customers with short patience and big mouths Physics everywhere, gravity sometimes Drive-thru for spaceships Upgrades you can actually see Questionable outfits
